newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up, volume falls.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up, volume falls.

text.p: Shanghai B share index ended up on Tuesday due to domestic individual buying, but trading volume fell due a slowdown in the morning during the funeral ceremony of Deng Xiaoping, brokers said.
Deng's funeral started at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday morning and lasted nearly one hour.
The B index inched up 0.589 points or 0.90 percent to 66.296 points on volume of 18.19 million shares worth $8.39 million, down from Monday's 21.998 million shares.
The domestic A share index rose 8.752 points or 0.83 percent to 1063.830 points.
"Most domestic investors were seen buying selective stocks actively on talk that the firms' 1996 results would show an improvement," one broker said.
Another broker said the index was likely to consolidate around 68 points in the short term with most overseas institutions taking a wait-and-see attitude on market uncertainties.
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded with 22 up, six flat and 13 down.
Shanghai Diesel Engine was the star on institutional window-dressing buying just ahead of the close, up $0.030 or 5.81 percent to $0.546 on volume of 290,000 shares.
Textile machinery maker Shanghai Erfangji traded the most on cross-trading, up 0.002 or 1.13 percent to $0.178 on volume of 1.8 million shares.
But market giant Shanghai Tyre and Rubber performed the worst on heavy liquidation selling on an expectation of poor results, losing $0.020 or 4.25 percent to 0.450 on volume of 1.8 million shares.

Shanghai A shares ended firmer after Monday's correction, with most investors unwilling to sell their shares at current levels because of strong confidence over the future of the stock market, brokers said.
A total of 663.8 million shares worth 6.4 billion yuan was traded, down from Monday's 1.0 billion shares.
The SSE30 index rose 25.231 points or 0.92 percent to 2776.469 points.
Ace Electronics Equipment was the star on speculative buying, soaring 0.97 yuan or 10.02 percent to 10.65 yuan on volume of 16.3 million shares.
